prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn signed_distance(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse canonical a;b, where each field is one signed decimal integer in -1000..1000. Return the absolute distance between a and b as a decimal string. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: -4;7 returns 11.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn signed_distance(s:&str)->Option<String>{let q:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if q.len()!=2{return None}let p=nums(q[0])?;let a=nums(q[1])?;if p.len()!=1||a.len()!=1{return None}let p=[p[0],a[0]];let d=(p[0]-p[1]).abs();Some(d.to_string())}
